title: Tales of the Ghetto by Leopold von Sacher Masoch.
html_source: Though a Catholic, Masoch wrote these romantic tales, which are sympathetic to the Jewish residents of the ghetto. He also, of course, gave his name to masochism – Bloom’s own masochistic fantasies will be revealed later in the Circe episode.
